name: Dal Fry
steps: Rinse the dal until the water is fairly clear. Simmer with 900 ml water and turmeric for 35–45 minutes, partly covered, until the grains mash easily; stir and check the water level.
Finely chop onion, tomato, ginger and garlic. Heat ghee in a pan, sizzle cumin, then cook onion for 6–8 minutes until golden at the edges.
Add ginger and garlic and stir for 1 minute. Add tomato, chilli powder and salt; cook for 8 minutes until soft and the ghee appears at the edges.
Whisk the cooked dal lightly and add to the pan with the remaining 200 ml water. Simmer for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until the dal pours thickly from a spoon.
Stir in garam masala and chopped coriander. Taste and serve hot with rice or roti prepared separately; this recipe supplies the dal only.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
